summary: Very steep kerb below a large apartment block, unit 11 m away.

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 11 m and 13 m away, a detached house 18 m, more flats within 40 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow kerb with a few cars parked near the junction; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street near a signalled junction.
drivers.convention: A handful of cars park here, none clearly overnight.

sun_shade: The tall block to the south shades the lower end; trees line the kerb above it.

best_section.where: Kings Road east kerb, uphill from the junction, beside the white apartment block
